title: Orbit Guard
description: Defend the Celestial Aegis planetary core! Summon orbital sentinels, merge identical units to ascend power tiers, and repel endless waves of void invaders in this mobile-first circular merge tower defense.
howToPlay: Tap or drag to buy and merge identical same-tier sentinels. Sentinels auto-attack invaders along their circular spiral path. Survive waves, defeat massive multi-phase bosses, upgrade workshop tech, and trigger Overcharge Surge!
